authPolicies.description: List of policy name to validate

authHosts.description: List of authorized hosts, i.e. host:8001

converters.description: List of assembly/JsonConvert type to apply

type.description:
JsonConverter class full name, i.e. web.Code.LocaleJsonConverter
Note: class needs a ctor with params object[] args, parameterless ctor will also evaluate as fallback

name.description: The unique name of the resource

userClaims.description: List of accociated user claims that should be included when this resource is requested

storedProcedure.description: Use stored procedure instead of EF methods

mappings.description: Map entity type to a set of stored procedure

methods.description: Call sp for this methods only; If empty: all methods

storedProcedure.description: Stored procedure name. Will be trasformed in {schema}.entity_{name}_{method}

idleTimeoutInMinutes.description: The IdleTimeout indicates how long the session can be idle before its contents are abandoned. Each session access resets the timeout. Note this only applies to the content of the session, not the cookie.

domain.description: The domain to associate the cookie with.

httpOnly.description: Indicates whether a cookie is accessible by client-side script.

securityDefinitions.description: Add one or more security definitions4, describing how your api is protected

bearer.description: Add Authorization header for bearer token

injectJs.description: Relative path of additional js file, added in wwwroot folder; i.e. "/swagger-ui/custom.js"

injectCss.description: Relative path of additional css file, added in wwwroot folder; i.e. "/swagger-ui/custom.css"

xmlComments.description:
To include Xml Comments, open the Properties dialog for your project, click the "Build" tab and ensure that "XML documentation file" is checked.
 This will produce a file containing all XML comments at build-time.
At this point, any classes or methods that are NOT annotated with XML comments will trigger a build warning.
 To suppress this, enter the warning code 1591 into the "Suppress warnings" field in the properties dialog.

fileName.description:
i.e. api.xml
Check PropertyGroup>DocumentationFile value in your .csproj file.

exposedHeaders.description: The CORS spec calls simple response headers. Specify other headers available to the application

allowCredentials.description: Credentials include cookies as well as HTTP authentication schemes

origins.description: To allow one or more specific origins

preflightMaxAgeInSeconds.description: Value in seconds. The Access-Control-Max-Age header specifies how long the response to the preflight request can be cached

ignore.description: Excludes the given entity type from the model. This method is typically used to remove types from the model that were added by convention., i.e. `MyNamespace.MyClass, MyAssembly`

jsonConvert.description:
Serialize/deserialize type, mapped on a text column, i.e. `MyNamespace.MyClass, MyAssembly`
Interface can be listed too

IdColumnName.description: Map Id property to column name

name.description: Name of the property, case sensitive

column.description: Name of the database column representing the property

ignore.description: Excludes the given property from the entity type

jsonConvert.description: Map property with text columun, serializing/deserializing value

namespace.description: Entity namespace (case sensitive) or leave empty

cliServerScript.description: Use only in development! The name of the script in your package.json file that launches the Angular CLI process, i.e. start. This handles requests by passing them through to an instance of the Angular CLI server; alternative to spaDevelopmentServer

defaultPage.description: Default page that hosts your SPA user interface

bootModuleBuilderScript.description: Use only in development! npm script that the prerenderer will invoke before looking for the boot module file, i.e. build:server

excludeUrls.description: "Array of URL prefixes for which prerendering should not run, i.e. "/sockjs-node""

contextData.description: Pass additional context data to the prerendering entrypoint code

bootModulePath.description: Path, relative to your application root, of the JavaScript file containing prerendering logic

cacheResponse.description: Cache prerendering output, injecting app ICache implementation

excludePaths.description: Array of path prefixes for which cache is disabled

includePaths.description: Array of path prefixes for which cache is always enabled

skipFilePath.description: If true, cache only extensionless path

skipQueryStringPath.description: If true, don't cache parameterized path

startupTimeoutInSeconds.description: Maximum duration that a request will wait for the SPA to become ready to serve to the client

spaDevelopmentServer.description: Use only in development! Forward incoming requests to a local development server,i.e. http://localhost:4200.

sourcePath.description: Path, relative to the application working directory, of the directory that contains the SPA source files during development. The directory may not exist in published applications

rootPath.description: Path relative to the application root, of the directory in which the physical files are located. If the specified directory does not exist, then the SpaStaticFiles middleware will not serve any static files.

folder.description: Folder of stored files, relative to ContentRootPath

routes.default: 2 routes: /healtz for basic app status, with no additional check; /healtz/checks for overall app status, performing all checks

skipChecks.description: If true skip any defined checks, returning a basic health check

processName.description: Check if exists, skip check if empty

serviceName.description: Check if running, skip check if empty

driver.description: i.e. C:\, skip check if empty

endpoints.description: List of health check endopoint to show

uri.description: i.e. http://host:8001/healthz, skip check if empty

dbPath.description: Db path relative to content root, i.e. files\db\healthchecksdb

payload.description: Encoded payload for failed check. Available token: [[LIVENESS]] [[FAILURE]] [[DESCRIPTIONS]]

restorePayload.description: Encoded payload for restored status. Available token: [[LIVENESS]]

clientSecrets.description: only relevant for flows that require a secret

allowedScopes.description: Specifies the api scopes that the client is allowed to request. If empty, the client can't access any scope

apiSecrets.description: The API secret is used for the introspection endpoint. The API can authenticate with introspection using the API name and secret

showInDiscoveryDocument.description: Specifies whether this scope is shown in the discovery document

items.description: An API must have at least one scope. Each scope can have different settings

jwtBearerClientAuthentication.description: Adds support for client authentication using JWT bearer assertions

except.description: Fully qualified name of the type, including its namespace but not its assembly

entity.description: Fully qualified name of the type, including its namespace but not its assembly

paths.description:
Array of indented navigation paths to include
i.e. for Order entity
[
 ["OrderDetail","Product","Supplier"],
 ["Customer"]
]

allOf.description: Sets the custom properties for the resource
